tokens.{heroName}: hero name chosen during the finale

shots.camera: wide crane over the smoking battlefield, dust drifting through orange light
handheld close-up on Tony's cracked faceplate as it folds away

line.speaker: TONY
line.text: Okay. Everybody's still standing. That's the part that matters.

shots.camera: low angle as the armored Titan's army closes in through the smoke
over-the-shoulder on Tony's hand, nanites crawling into the shape of stones

line.speaker: FRIDAY
line.text: Boss, that power will tear you apart. Please reconsider.

shots.camera: tight on Tony's eyes, reflecting six colors

line.speaker: TONY
line.text: I did the math a long time ago, FRIDAY.

shots.camera: slow push-in on the gauntlet as every stone ignites
extreme close-up on the arc reactor, light stuttering
profile shot, Tony bracing, jaw set against the pain

line.speaker: TONY
line.text: Come on, you damn thing. One more good day.

shots.camera: macro on two fingers pressed together, frame shaking
shots.sfx: silence, then a single crisp snap

shots.camera: wide shot as white light washes across the battlefield and the army turns to ash
shots.sfx: whoosh of drifting ash, then quiet

shots.camera: slow dolly down to Tony slumped against twisted steel

line.speaker: PEPPER
line.text: I'm here. Breathe with me. Everything else can wait.

shots.camera: close two-shot, foreheads almost touching, reactor light fading

line.speaker: TONY
line.text: Tell Morgan to stay loud and curious. Tell her I was proud. Every day.

shots.camera: insert on the reactor's glow shrinking to a single blue point; a flicker of memory: a snowy Tennessee garage

line.speaker: TONY
line.text: And the Tennessee kid... make sure that kid gets the keys. Leave the lights on.

shots.sfx: final faint chime, distant wind chime

shots.camera: high wide pull-away over the quiet field as the sun breaks through
fade to black, title card: years later
night, lake house: {playerName}, now a teenager, turns over a dented garage-door remote tagged FOR THE MECHANIC

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Mom says Dad left it to you in the will. Just you. Rude.

shots.camera: the remote clicks; ivy parts as a sealed steel door slides open beside the boathouse

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Same remote as my old garage in Tennessee. Tony, you sentimental show-off.

shots.camera: wide interior as dust sheets slide off workbenches

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Morgan... this whole place has been waiting for us.

shots.camera: rack focus to two robot arms slumped in the corner
close on Dum-E's claw twitching awake

line.speaker: DUM-E
line.text: *whirr... beep-beep!* (snaps upright, knocks over a broom)

shots.camera: U swivels toward the player and offers a fire extinguisher

line.speaker: U
line.text: *bweep?* (offers extinguisher like a welcome gift)

shots.camera: push-in on a dusty console as {playerName} plugs in a portable drive

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Backup restored. Ah, the mechanic from Tennessee. Tony said you would come, {playerName}.

shots.camera: Morgan drops into the battered workshop chair and spins once

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Calling it. I'm officially the guy in the chair.

objectives.text: Restore power to the workshop by reaching the breaker panel on foot.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Breaker panel's behind the dented cabinet. Mind the loose cables.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Mind the floor. Dum-E has been tidying for several years.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Lights! Guy in the chair, delivering results since tonight.

objectives.text: Disable the rogue training drones with the Mark I's flamethrower.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Old training drones woke up grumpy. Four of them.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Two down! Dum-E is cheering. Or short-circuiting. Hard to tell.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Training drones neutralized. A crude suit, but a fine pilot.

shots.camera: low angle on the clanking Mark I, steam venting from its joints

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: It's heavy, loud, and held together with hope. I love it.

shots.camera: bench close-up: Morgan and {playerName} wire a scavenged reactor ring into the suit's spine housing

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Dad's spare parts, my soldering, your back. Hold still.

shots.camera: Dum-E grabs the glowing ring, fumbles it; U snatches it out of the air

line.speaker: DUM-E
line.text: *bweep-BWOOP!* (juggles the ring; U catches it, very smug)

shots.camera: macro on the makeshift arc reactor sputtering to life on the suit's back, orange edging into blue

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Makeshift reactor online. It runs hot. I advise against hugging it.

shots.camera: Dum-E proudly sprays the smoking reactor housing with foam

line.speaker: DUM-E
line.text: *BWEEEP!* (extinguisher fires; foam everywhere)

shots.camera: JARVIS hologram ripples into a soft blue outline

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: The first of these was built in a cave, with worse tools. Your turn.

shots.camera: Morgan grinning from the chair, headset crooked

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Tomorrow we fly. Tonight you clean foam. I'm the little sister; I supervise.

reactor.note: Scavenged ring from Tony's spare parts, soldered by Morgan into the spine housing. Runs hot.

shots.camera: slow orbit around the bare chrome Mark II on a water-tower rooftop at dusk
HUD point-of-view as flight diagnostics bloom, a reactor heat gauge ticking upward

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Start at ten percent thrust. Ambition can wait until you have altitude.

shots.camera: close on the spine-mounted reactor venting a ribbon of heat

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Last broken suit I worked on crashed through my garage roof in a snowstorm.

shots.camera: JARVIS hologram warms beside the HUD

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: You lent him your tools and your nerve. Tonight he lends you his.

shots.camera: cut to the workshop: Morgan cracks her knuckles over three monitors

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Guy in the chair, online. U brought me snacks.

shots.camera: U drops a bag of chips into Morgan's lap

line.speaker: U
line.text: *whirr-click* (pats the bag twice, very proud)

shots.camera: over-the-shoulder on {playerName} at the roof's edge

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Ten percent. Totally reasonable. Not scary at all.

objectives.text: Take off and land on the far helipad.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Helipad's three roofs east. Big H. Impossible to overlook.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Ease the left stabilizer. You are flying, not wrestling.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: You stuck the landing! I screamed. U dropped the snacks.

objectives.text: Clear a scavenger drone wave circling the rooftops.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Scavenger drones. Somebody's been selling Stark scrap online.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: One's flanking low. Your left, under the antenna.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Wave clear. The chair approves. The chair is very comfy.

shots.camera: wide shot of {playerName} hovering above the skyline, city lights below

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Morgan. I can see your house from here.

shots.camera: Morgan in the chair, mouth full of chips

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Great. Don't tell Mom about any of this.

shots.camera: close on a scavenger drone's shattered lens flickering red
the red light pulses into a jagged glyph, then dies

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: ...a new toy in the old toybox. How charming.

shots.camera: back in the workshop, the gantry lowers a fresh red and gold suit

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: The Mark III. Red, gold, and considerably less frostbite.

reactor.note: Holds for first flight; heat gauge climbs fast at full thrust.

shots.camera: drone shot over downtown, the rusting Stark Expo globe at the city's edge, traffic lights blinking erratically
street level as delivery drones turn in unison, eyes going red

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: Strings are such a lovely thing. Everyone has them.

shots.camera: workshop: JARVIS's hologram flickers, unsettled

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: That signature. I had hoped it was deleted forever.

shots.camera: Morgan leans close to a monitor, eyes narrowing

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: It's riding the delivery network. I can trace it if you buy time.

shots.camera: Mark III boot-up, faceplate sealing over {playerName}

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Buying time. I'm good at that. Mostly.

objectives.text: Hold the intersection against two corrupted drone waves.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Two waves inbound down Fifth. I'm muting traffic lights for you.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Hacked a billboard. Their targeting hates bright pink. You're welcome.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Intersection secured. Civilians are clearing the area.

objectives.text: Destroy the tank bots rolling out of the abandoned Stark Expo pavilion.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Tank bots, out of the old Expo hall! Dad threw huge parties there.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Rerouting power to your repulsors. Hit the treads.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Both tanks scrapped, {playerName}. Sorry, Expo. You were already a ruin.

shots.camera: smoking tank bot hull, a red glyph burning across its armor

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: You wear a dead hero's shell, little one. It doesn't fit.

shots.camera: tight on {playerName}'s faceplate, reflecting the glyph

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Then I'll grow into it.

shots.camera: repulsor blast, the glyph shatters into sparks
workshop: Morgan pumps a fist, sending chips flying

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Trace locked! It's hiding in an old drop-pod network.

shots.camera: Dum-E clutches a missile rack like a trophy

line.speaker: DUM-E
line.text: *beep-boop-BEEP* (waves the Mark VII missile pod around)

shots.camera: JARVIS gently takes the pod with a holo-prompt

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Perhaps the explosives go on the suit, not on you.

reactor.note: Survives the Expo fight, but vents smoke after every unibeam.

shots.camera: night wide shot, rain sheeting off dark towers
workshop: a pair of old sunglasses on the bench begins to glow

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Dad's sunglasses just... texted me. Is that normal?

shots.camera: glasses unfold an amber interface over the room

line.speaker: EDITH
line.text: EDITH online. Clearance confirmed. Please don't drop me in soup again.

shots.camera: Morgan in the chair, delighted and appalled

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: That was one time. I was six.

shots.camera: tactical overlay maps drone patrols across the city grid

line.speaker: EDITH
line.text: Twelve drones guard a relay. Quietly is an option. Loudly is faster.

objectives.text: Fly low through the rain and reach the relay tower unseen.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Patrol gaps every eight seconds. I'll count you in.

comms.speaker: EDITH
comms.text: Altitude is generous. Stay under the billboards.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: You're at the relay. My hands are shaking. Chair is fine.

objectives.text: Keep the makeshift reactor from overheating: no forced landing while the relay falls.
objectives.system: P.en / CONFIG.player.flightDrain + groundRegen; fail state = POWER DEPLETED banner

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Reactor's running hot. Land to cool it before your energy hits zero.

comms.speaker: EDITH
comms.text: Heat at eighty percent. Ground time recommended. Strongly.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: No forced landings! The reactor survived. So did my fingernails.

objectives.text: Take down the relay's drone guard.

comms.speaker: EDITH
comms.text: Twelve hostiles. I've painted the weakest optics.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Hacked three of them. They're shooting each other now.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Relay's dark! EDITH says I'm adequate. That's a compliment, right?

shots.camera: relay tower sparking out, rain hissing on hot metal
close on EDITH's overlay decoding a stolen file

line.speaker: EDITH
line.text: Ultron's fragments are assembling something in the old battle ruins.

shots.camera: insert: a schematic of a colossal black armored figure
Morgan stares at the schematic, chips forgotten

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: That's not a drone. That's a building with opinions.

shots.camera: matte gray Mark XV shimmers into view behind {playerName}

line.speaker: EDITH
line.text: Stealth plating ready. Try not to bump into anything.

reactor.note: Overheating in the rain; heat is managed through the energy system (land to cool).

shots.camera: wide crane over the scorched ruins where the final battle was fought
{playerName} touches a melted shard of red armor

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: This is where it ended. And, in a way, where you began.

shots.camera: the ground splits; an obsidian hand claws upward
extreme low angle as the OBSIDIAN TITAN rises, red veins pulsing

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: Behold my new body. Hand-built from your hero's rubble.

shots.camera: workshop: Morgan grips the desk with both hands

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Okay. Okay. Guy in the chair is panicking professionally.

objectives.text: Survive the escort drones swarming out of the ruins.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Escort drones first. Thin them before the big one wakes.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Use the broken girders for cover. They were good to Tony.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Escorts down. The Titan's armor is warming up. Bad sign.

objectives.text: Defeat the OBSIDIAN TITAN.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Weak point is the chest seam. Wait for it to glow.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Phase two! Missile pods! I'm jamming what I can!

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: The Titan is down. Its core, however, has fled.

shots.camera: the Titan's core streaks into the sky as the body collapses
macro on the spine-mounted reactor: a crack spreads, the light gutters and dies

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Reactor's dead! {playerName}, move! Nobody leaves my big brother in the dirt!

shots.camera: {playerName} on one knee, armor dark and smoking

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: I can't... the suit won't stand. No power.

shots.camera: pale light descends; a chalk-white synthetic figure, colorless as bone, lands softly

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: Please, allow me. You fought bravely, {playerName}.

shots.camera: two-shot: Vison offers a hand, a dim, empty socket where a gem once sat

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: You're... I read about you. You're supposed to be gone.

shots.camera: close on Vison, gentle half-smile

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: I was rebuilt. My memories feel borrowed. Still, call, and I will come.

shots.camera: workshop: Morgan nearly falls out of the chair

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: We have a Vison now?! I'm adding a button for that.

reactor.note: Cracks and dies after the Titan fight; Vison carries the dead suit out.

shots.camera: workshop: U and Dum-E tug a huge tarp off a hulking orange frame

line.speaker: DUM-E
line.text: *WHIRR-WHIRR-beep!* (tarp tangles around its claw)

shots.camera: U digs a dented, homemade potato cannon out of a crate and proudly aims it at Dum-E

line.speaker: U
line.text: *whirr-CHUNK* (fires; a potato bonks Dum-E's claw)

shots.camera: {playerName} grabs the cannon, grinning in disbelief

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: That's mine! Tony borrowed it the winter he crashed. Never gave it back.

shots.camera: JARVIS hologram, deadpan, beside the potato cannon

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: He kept it by the bench. He called it his lucky Tennessee artillery.

shots.camera: new voice, warm and brisk, as the room's lights shift green

line.speaker: FRIDAY
line.text: Right so, FRIDAY here. Somebody's been playing with the big toys, boss.

shots.camera: Morgan spins the chair toward the ceiling speaker

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: FRIDAY! It's Morgan! I'm the guy in the chair now.

shots.camera: FRIDAY's waveform pulses, amused

line.speaker: FRIDAY
line.text: You're not a guy, love. But grand. Brief me.

shots.camera: {playerName} straps the patched reactor on as tank bots crawl over the ruins on screen

line.speaker: FRIDAY
line.text: Tank column in the ruins, boss. That's what the big lad's for.

objectives.text: Stall the tank bot column before it reaches the highway.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Five tanks, single file. Stay off their firing line.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Shells landing close, boss. Keep your feet moving.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Column broken! Highway's safe. My heart rate is not.

objectives.text: Deploy the Hulkbuster and smash the armored bunker.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Beacon's charged. Press the big scary button.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Big suit has its own power, boss. Your reactor gets a breather.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Bunker flattened. Dum-E is doing a victory spin.

objectives.text: Search the bunker on foot for Ultron's stolen data.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Doors are hacked open. Go grab whatever's blinking.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Data drive's behind the third console, boss.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Got it! Downloading. Possibly also a virus. Kidding. Mostly.

shots.camera: workshop: stolen data scrolls across every screen

line.speaker: FRIDAY
line.text: Ultron's rebuilding the Titan, boss. Bigger. Over the skyline.

shots.camera: Morgan pulls both knees up onto the chair

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: So we're fighting a skyscraper. On a school night.

shots.camera: late night: Morgan sketches a triangular core over one of Dad's old element diagrams

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Dad invented a whole new element once. I can invent one reactor.

shots.camera: {playerName} drapes a blanket over Morgan's shoulders as she keeps drawing

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: You're the annoying big brother I never asked for. Don't you dare break.

shots.camera: Dum-E nudges a mug of cocoa toward Morgan's blueprint

line.speaker: DUM-E
line.text: *bwoop* (slides cocoa over, spills only half, misses the blueprint)

shots.camera: {playerName} rests a hand on the new Mark XLVII

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Then we sleep, we build, and we finish this. Together, Morgan.

reactor.note: Taped and re-soldered; Hulkbuster carries the load while Morgan designs a replacement.

shots.camera: dawn wide over the rooftops, the rebuilt Titan looming between towers
Ultron's face projected across a dozen billboards

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: The city wakes to a new skyline. Mine.

shots.camera: workshop: Morgan's triangular reactor clicks into the forearm housing, glowing a clean white-blue

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Morgan-and-{playerName} reactor, version one. Runs cool. Mostly.

shots.camera: {playerName} launches off a helipad in the Mark XLVII

line.speaker: FRIDAY
line.text: Wheels up, boss. Wind's mad, but you're madder.

shots.camera: workshop: Morgan slaps a new button labeled VISON

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Vison button is live. Use it wisely. Or constantly.

shots.camera: Vison, still pale, phases through a tower wall to join the flight

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: Good morning. Shall we take back the skyline together?

shots.camera: billboards flicker to Ultron's face, turned toward Vison

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: My wayward child. Still wearing memories that belong to someone else?

shots.camera: close on Vison, a faint warmth of color returning to the pale face

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: They are mine now. I decide what they mean.

objectives.text: Clear three drone waves from the rooftops. Vison can be summoned.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Three waves, every roof. Tap the Vison button if it gets messy.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Rerouting suit power to thrusters. You'll feel a kick.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Rooftops clear, boss. The big one's turning to face you.

objectives.text: Defeat the rebuilt OBSIDIAN TITAN above the city.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: It's tougher now. Chest seam is shielded until phase two.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Shield's down! Phase three, it's ramming! Dodge, dodge, dodge!

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: IT'S DOWN! The chair is screaming! Neighbors probably heard!

shots.camera: the Titan crashes onto an empty rooftop, red veins dimming
its core escapes again, but this time it dives toward the outskirts
EDITH overlay tracks the trajectory to a familiar location

line.speaker: EDITH
line.text: Core heading to the lake house. And the workshop beneath it.

shots.camera: Morgan freezes, one hand over her mouth

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: It's coming home. It's coming here.

shots.camera: nanite housing unfolds on the workbench: the Mark L

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Nanotech armor. Tony's design. It's time.

reactor.note: Morgan's triangular core, echoing Tony's new-element design, mounted on the forearm housing.

shots.camera: Hall of Armor: every earned suit glows in its glass pod as a floor safe opens on JARVIS's command

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Tony left one final schematic, sealed for someone worthy.

shots.camera: push-in on a glowing blueprint labeled MARK 85
Morgan reads the margin notes, voice cracking

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: That's Dad's handwriting. There's a little smiley face.

shots.camera: U and Dum-E fetch tools without being asked, perfectly in sync

line.speaker: U
line.text: *whirr... beep* (hands over the exact right wrench)

shots.camera: city skyline: Ultron's corrupted drones block the road to the lake house

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: Build all you like. I've learned to unbuild.

objectives.text: Fight through the blockade on foot to the stalled convoy.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Convoy has the arc cores we need. Get them out.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Lovely footwork, boss. Two blocks to go.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Convoy's moving! I hacked every green light ahead of it.

objectives.text: Destroy the tank bots shelling the convoy route.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Tanks on the overpass. Shells incoming in three, two...

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Juicing your unibeam. Fire when you see the glow.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Route clear. The cores will reach the workshop.

objectives.text: Hold the city line while the Mark 85 is assembled.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: U and Dum-E need ninety seconds. Hold the line.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Dum-E dropped a bolt. Okay, ninety-five seconds.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Mark 85 is ready! Get home, {playerName}!

shots.camera: Mark 85 nanites flow over {playerName} in a golden wave
HUD warms gold; JARVIS, FRIDAY and EDITH speak in turn

line.speaker: FRIDAY
line.text: All three of us, one suit. Tony would've loved this, boss.

shots.camera: EDITH dry, overlay snapping into place

line.speaker: EDITH
line.text: Tactically, this is overkill. Emotionally, I approve.

shots.camera: lake house horizon: the Titan's core descends, dragging a storm with it

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: Let's finish this where it all ended.

reactor.note: Morgan's core powers the Mark 85, mounted off-chest in the forearm housing.

shots.camera: the storm breaks over the lake house as the final Titan lands
workshop lights flicker; screens fill with red code

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Ultron is inside our systems. I am holding the door.

shots.camera: Morgan types furiously, jaw clenched

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Not my chair. Not my workshop. Get out!

shots.camera: U and Dum-E brace themselves against the server rack

line.speaker: DUM-E
line.text: *BWEEP-BWEEP!* (wedges a claw into the door frame)

shots.camera: Mark 85 lands in the clearing, facing the storm

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: I will guard the house. You guard what matters.

objectives.text: Defend the workshop from Ultron's final drone waves.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Drones on every side. I'm firewalling the doors.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Firewall holding at forty percent. Keep them off the roof.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Waves cleared! Firewall's still up. Barely.

objectives.text: Call in the Hulkbuster to crack the Titan's storm shield.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Shield's too thick for nanites, boss. Bring the big lad.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Shield at half! Keep punching! Punch it more!

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Shield's gone! It's just you and the Titan now.

objectives.text: Defeat the OBSIDIAN TITAN and reach Ultron's exposed core.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Final Titan, {playerName}. Every trick it knows, all at once.

comms.speaker: EDITH
comms.text: Phase three. The core is surfacing. Get close.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: It's down! The core is open. Don't touch it. Wait. Touch it?

shots.camera: close on Ultron's exposed core, red light snarling

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: Destroy me, then. Be just like them. Smash what frightens you.

shots.camera: {playerName} kneels, hand hovering over the core

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: No. You were built to protect people. Somebody just did it wrong.

shots.camera: JARVIS's blue code threads into the red, slowly calming it

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Let me help. I remember what you were supposed to be.

shots.camera: Vison kneels beside {playerName}, palm over the core

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: There is a quiet room in my mind where many voices share space. Rest there.

shots.camera: Morgan, from the chair, whispers into the mic

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Rerouting the arc reactor into the core. Gently. Gently.

shots.camera: the core's glow shifts from red to violet-white

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: ...Quiet. It's quiet for the first time. What... am I?

shots.camera: {playerName} smiles inside the helmet

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: My partner. If you want to be.

shots.camera: the Ultron suit assembles around the core, sleek and silver-violet

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: Then I will try. Show me how heroes do it.

reactor.note: Morgan's core is rerouted to calm the Ultron code during the twist.

shots.camera: dawn after the storm, mist on the lake, the workshop door open
U and Dum-E carry a dusty arc reactor case out of the hidden vault

line.speaker: U
line.text: *whirr-beep* (presents the case with great ceremony)

shots.camera: close on Tony's old reactor ring fitted around Morgan's core in the Mark 85's forearm housing

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Dad's ring, my core. Finally, a reactor that doesn't catch fire.

shots.camera: a hologram of Tony flickers to life above the bench

line.speaker: TONY
line.text: Hey, mechanic. If this plays, you found the garage I owed you.

shots.camera: medium on hologram Tony, leaning casually on a workbench

line.speaker: TONY
line.text: You patched me up with junk and nerve once. Your turn to patch up the world.

shots.camera: Morgan, eyes wet, one hand pressed flat on the bench

line.speaker: TONY
line.text: And Morgan. If you're in that chair, you're the best part of me.

shots.camera: close on Morgan laughing through tears

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Told you. Guy in the chair. It's literally in the will.

shots.camera: hologram Tony looks straight into the lens

line.speaker: TONY
line.text: Don't be me. Be better. Pick your own name. Then go live it.

shots.camera: Vison stands at the doorway, full color restored, sunlight behind

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: So, {playerName}. What shall the world call you?

shots.camera: name-entry prompt over a slow push-in on {playerName}

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Call me {heroName}.

shots.camera: Morgan steps onto the platform; Rescue armor folds around her

line.speaker: FRIDAY
line.text: Rescue's sealed, Morgan. Your mam would be proud. Fly safe.

shots.camera: Morgan grins inside the Rescue helmet

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Just this once. Someone else gets the chair today.

shots.camera: Dum-E rolls into the empty chair and spins, delighted

line.speaker: DUM-E
line.text: *BEEP-BEEP-whirrrr!* (spins the chair three full turns)

shots.camera: wide crane up as two armored figures lift off over the lake into sunrise

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: Altitude rising. For once, I'd like to see what we save.

shots.camera: final shot: in the Hall of Armor a new pod lights up beneath the name {heroName}; title card fades in

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Welcome to the family, {heroName}.

reactor.note: Tony's original reactor ring fitted around Morgan's core; never in the chest.
